The Quiet Chapter · 01

Har Kahani Ka Ek Khamosh Aaghaz Hota Hai…

Kuch kahaniyan shor se nahi, ek khamosh ehsaas se shuru hoti hain.

Shuru mein sab kuch bilkul aam hota hai—kuch mulaqatein, kuch chhoti si baatein, aur ek aisa rishta jise hum kabhi alag nazar se dekhte hi nahi.

Phir waqt dheere-dheere kuch badal deta hai. Ek chehra bheed mein bhi alag lagne lagta hai. Ek chhota sa notification dil ki dhadkan tez kar deta hai. Aur ek naam, bina kuch kahe, din ka sabse khoobsurat hissa ban jaata hai.

Yeh kahani bhi kuch aisi hi hai—kuch adhure sawaalon, chhoti si muskurahat, khamosh intezaar aur un ehsaason ki, jo kehne se pehle hi dil mein apni jagah bana chuke the.

— Ek kahani, jo abhi likhi ja rahi hai

Chapter One

Ek Purana Ehsaas

Asia meri cousin hai. Bachpan se hum ek doosre ko jaante the. Ghar walon ka aana-jaana hota rehta tha, isliye milna bhi koi nayi baat nahi thi. Us waqt na mere dil mein koi khaas ehsaas tha, na maine kabhi is rishte ko kisi aur nazar se dekha.

Main waise bhi zyada bolne wala insaan nahi hoon—na doston ke beech, na ghar par. Lekin 9th class ke aas-paas, jab woh kuch din hamare ghar ruki, mere andar kuch badalne laga.

Mujhe woh achhi lagne lagi thi. Main keh nahi paaya. Dar tha ke kahin meri baat se woh uncomfortable na ho jaaye, ya hamare darmiyan jo apnapan tha woh bhi badal na jaaye.

Kabhi dil mein khayal aata ke shayad uske dil mein bhi kuch ho… phir khud hi us khayal ko rok deta. Mere paas koi jawaab nahi tha—sirf ek khamosh ehsaas tha.

Chapter Two

Chaar Saal Ki Khamoshi

Phir padhai ke liye main ghar se door chala gaya. Chaar saal guzar gaye. Na online baat, na SMS, na social media par koi contact. Bas kabhi gaon mein shaadi ya family visit ke dauran saamna ho jaata—shayad saal mein ek baar.

Hum milte toh the, lekin baat nahi hoti thi. Aur ajeeb baat yeh thi ke usse dekhta toh dil ki dhadkan phir tez ho jaati, jaise waqt beech mein guzra hi na ho.

4 April 2026 ko main ghar wapas aaya aur kuch mahine wahin raha. Us dauran use ek-do baar dekha. Wahi purana ehsaas phir saamne aa gaya, lekin main ab bhi kuch kehne ki himmat nahi juta paaya.

Kabhi-kabhi zindagi do logon ko paas rakhti hai, lekin unke darmiyan lafzon ka faasla bohot lamba hota hai.

Chapter Three

Woh Pehla Notification

Ek din family ke silsile mein mera number unke ghar ke phone tak pahunch gaya. Phir Snapchat par ek request aayi—account ka naam “ch” se shuru hota tha.

Request dekhte hi dil ajeeb tarah se dhadakne laga. Maine accept ki. Uski taraf se ek random black snap aaya, maine bhi ek random photo bhej di.

Phir kareeb ek mahine tak hum random snaps, quotes aur photos share karte rahe. Koi khaas conversation nahi hoti thi, lekin chhoti-chhoti cheezein mere liye khaas banne lagi thi.

Kabhi woh apni photo bhejti, kabhi meri photo par purple ya red heart react karti, kabhi flower 🌹 bhej deti. Agar main apni ya apni niece ki photo bhejta, toh woh save bhi kar leti.

Main in chhoti baaton se umeed bana leta, phir khud ko yaad dilata: shayad main bas zyada soch raha hoon. Mujhe ab bhi uske dil ki baat maloom nahi thi.

Chapter Four

“Last Snap” Aur Woh Din

19 September 2026 ko uska snap aaya: “guys last snap ma ja rahi hu bye 👋”. Mujhe laga shayad ab baat khatam ho jaayegi. Maine poochha ke kya woh Srinagar ja rahi hai. Usne message dekha, lekin reply nahi aaya.

20 September ko usne ek photo snap bheja. Maine screenshot le liya—aur agle hi pal ghabrahat ne gher liya. Haath kaanpne lage. Usse screenshot ka pata chal gaya aur woh naraaz ho gayi. Usne photo delete karne ko kaha aur bataya ke use apni photo kisi ke phone mein rehna pasand nahi.

Uska privacy ko lekar naraaz hona uska haq tha. Mujhe apni ghalti ka ehsaas tha. Lekin us waqt main sirf screenshot ke baare mein nahi soch raha tha; mujhe darr tha ke kahin hamara chhota sa connection aur mere dil ke sawaal hamesha ke liye khatam na ho jaayein.

Usne kaha, “aap dil se bade masoom dikhte ho but dil ke bahut bure ho.” Main andar se hil gaya. Maine photo delete ki aur use bata diya. Phir usne “thankyou bro” kaha aur gusse ke liye maafi bhi maangi.

“Bro” ka lafz mujhe bohot chubha. Maine samjha shayad mere sawaal ka jawaab mil gaya hai—haalanki asal mein main uske dil ki baat jaanta hi nahi tha.

Chapter Five

Woh Raat, Phir Ek Nayi Subah

Maine kaha ke ab main snaps ya messages nahi bhejunga. Ek emotional story post ki aur phir use Snapchat se remove kar diya.

Us raat neend nahi aayi. Dil ghabrata raha, aankhen bhar aayi, kuch khaane ya kisi se baat karne ka mann nahi hua. Maine phone bhi band kar diya. Baar-baar yahi sochta raha ke shayad maine apni hi ghalti se sab kharab kar diya.

Agli subah uski taraf se dobara request aayi. Maine accept ki. Usne maafi maangi aur samjhaya ke woh bas screenshot se uncomfortable thi; use andaza nahi tha ke main itna hurt ho jaunga.

Maine kaha ke baat theek hai, lekin mujhe bura laga tha. Dheere-dheere hum phir normal baat karne lage—“kya kar rahe ho?”, “kaise ho?”, “kahan ho?” Jaise beech ka faasla thoda kam ho raha ho.

Uske message ka notification aata toh main jo bhi kar raha hota, ruk kar dekh leta. Phir kuch der tak chehre par muskurahat rehti. Main jaldi mein kuch kehna nahi chahta tha; pehle ek doosre ko samajhna chahta tha.

Chapter Six

5 October — “I Love You Too”

Waqt ke saath baat-cheet behtar hoti gayi. Humne photos share ki, apni chhoti-chhoti baatein batane lage. Phir ek aur misunderstanding hui. Maine phir se keh diya ke ab snaps aur messages nahi, bye.

Is baar usne apni naraazgi batayi. Usne kaha ke mujhe samajhne ki koshish karni chahiye thi; woh nahi chahti thi ke main itni jaldi sab khatam kar doon. Maine uski baat suni, apni taraf se samjha aur humne misunderstanding clear kar li.

Phir aaya 5 October 2026. Maine woh baat keh di jo saalon se dil mein thi: “I love you.”

Aur uska jawaab tha—“I love you too.”

Woh kuch lafz the, lekin mere liye un tak pahunchne ka safar bohot lamba tha. Saalon ki khamoshi, bechaini aur sawaalon ke baad pehli baar laga ke shayad ab kahani sirf mere dil mein nahi reh gayi.

Chapter Seven

Ek Chhoti Si Ring

Uske liye ring lene ka khayal aaya, lekin mujhe samajh nahi aa raha tha ke kaunsi ring use pasand aayegi. Main shop par gaya. Wahan ek lady shopping kar rahi thi, toh maine unse poochha ke kisi ke liye ring choose karni ho toh kya dekhoon.

Unhone poochha kis ke liye hai, phir mujhe kai rings dikhayi. Maine ek choose kar li. Ab bhi nahi pata ke Asia ko woh pasand aayegi ya nahi.

Lekin shayad gift ki khoobsurati sirf uski keemat ya design mein nahi hoti. Kabhi-kabhi uske peeche chhupi koshish mein hoti hai—kisi ko khush dekhne ki chhoti si umeed mein.

Hum roz baat karte hain, lekin propose karne ke baad abhi tak saamne baith kar milna nahi hua. Sochta hoon jab milenge toh kya kahunga? Kahin aisa na ho ke saare lafz dil mein hi reh jaayein.

Chapter Eight

Abhi Kahani Jaari Hai

Shayad mujhe abhi bhi sab kuch nahi pata. Main nahi jaanta agla mod kya hoga, pehli mulaqat kaisi hogi, ya main apne dil ki baat saamne baith kar kitni achhi tarah keh paunga.

Lekin itna zaroor jaanta hoon: kuch log zindagi mein pehle se maujood hote hain, magar unki ahmiyat samajhne mein waqt lagta hai. Kabhi ek notification, ek maafi, ek sachchi baat ya ek chhoti si ring humein apne ehsaas aur saaf dikha deti hai.

Yeh kahani perfect nahi hai. Ismein galatfahmiyan bhi hain, khamoshiyan bhi, ghaltiyan bhi aur unhein samajhne ki koshish bhi. Main nahi chahta ke koi ghalti khoobsurat bana kar dikhayi jaaye—bas itna chahta hoon ke hum ek doosre ki izzat karein, samjhein aur khul kar baat karna seekhein.

Kuch ehsaas kahe nahi jaate…
bas waqt ke saath ek kahani ban jaate hain.

Aur hamari kahani… abhi likhi ja rahi hai. ♥
